name: @cc/dsh-test-cases
description: A repo-tracked library of observed test cases (docs/cases/): twelve schema-enforced tools that record a requirement, EXECUTE the stored check (case_run: exit code, duration, typed metric/count/hash checks from the driver CASE_SUMMARY, artifacts, repeated runs with median/p95/flaky and a baseline ratchet), record a measured negative-control red, run a suite, gate task close, and keep compare-and-set history and surface-file drift.
